text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention salads lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one dish was described as bland. There are also concerns about the limited menu range and the absence of cups for water, which affected the overall value perception. Service was mentioned once in a critical context. These points suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and related services.

windows.60: Visitor feedback over the last 60 days highlights several issues with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Multiple reviews mention that some menu items lack flavor or have unusual combinations, and one visitor described the food as overpriced and minimal. There were also comments about limited menu options and dissatisfaction with service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Overall, the average rating is low, indicating that improvements in food quality and customer service are needed.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate several issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality inconsistent, with specific complaints about bland or poorly prepared dishes and a lack of variety. Service problems were noted, including long wait times and occasional closures of the kitchen without clear communication. Some visitors also mentioned concerns about value, feeling the food was overpriced for what was offered. Overall, these areas may need attention to improve the visitor experience.
